free_tier.stated: unlimited photos/videos, but only with an active paid Yandex 360 plan; free accounts have those files counted against the 5 GB

egress.terms: free view/download from the web and app

tooling: Yandex Disk REST/API is the same one rclone uses, but the unlimited bucket is only reachable via the mobile auto-upload path, not the upload API
chaining: does not multiply — the 'unlimited' is a plan benefit, not a free-tier property; lapses back to metered when the plan ends
limits_note: RAW DNG files are excluded and count against quota; photos in unlimited storage do not sync to desktop; uploads happen only from the mobile client
reliability_note: Reading it as a free store is a trap: without a paid plan the media occupies quota and over-quota disks get blocked at 44 days and wiped at 90.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
